plugins.name: probertson-review
plugins.description: Code-review toolkit: self-review your own diff, review someone else's branch in a throwaway worktree, and a shared set of generic (non-proprietary) review guidelines — plus the code-reviewer agent that applies them. Self-contained; no dependencies.

plugins.name: probertson-create-pr
plugins.description: Push the current branch and open a GitHub pull request with a real multi-line Markdown description via the gh CLI. Just the open-the-PR step.

plugins.name: probertson-ship-it
plugins.description: One-command ship: self-review the branch diff, optionally bump a CHANGELOG, then open the PR. Stops at an open PR — does not merge.

plugins.name: probertson-review-hook
plugins.description: Opt-in guardrail: a PreToolUse hook that blocks git commit until self-review has run in the session. Install this only if you want the commit block enforced automatically.
